diagnosis: Mission01EnvironmentRoot retains the default non-static mobility. OnConstruction changes OceanTiles, BeachTiles, and LandTiles to Static. Subsequent registration or reconstruction therefore attempts to attach static children to a non-static parent, which UE 5.8 rejects.
smallest_production_valid_correction: Set Mission01EnvironmentRoot mobility to Static immediately after CreateDefaultSubobject and before SetRootComponent or any child SetupAttachment call.
